# GEN-3 record set (generated by tools/gen/abstract/extract; do not edit)

Records are suggestions shown to a model, never trusted code. Part of aien-spark/omega#478.

| file | what it is |
|---|---|
| raw/, abstraction/, receipts/ | records (RECORD_SCHEMA.md v1) and the receipts of the checks that produced them |
| MANIFEST, SET.sha256 | every record with its sha256; SET.sha256 is the sha256 of MANIFEST |
| PREFIX | the 14 B-prefix task ids (GEN_PROTOCOL_V1 section 3 pick rule) |
| C.MANIFEST | condition C pool: raw records, split corpus, not in PREFIX |
| D.MANIFEST | condition D pool: abstraction records, split corpus, ancestry not entirely in PREFIX |
| FAMRULE.receipt | famsig rule dev/META vs corpus/META at the pinned FAMSIG commit; extract writes nothing without RULE PASS |
| REJECTIONS | helper groups that did not become abstraction records, with the reason |

## C/D asymmetry

The two arms do not draw from pools of the same size or the same record length. Retrieval takes k = 3 records
under cap_bytes = 4096 from each pool, so this difference is part of what C versus D compares.

| arm | pool | eligible records | median body bytes |
|---|---|---|---|
| C | C.MANIFEST (raw: whole corpus solutions) | 23 | 196 |
| D | D.MANIFEST (abstraction: single verified helpers) | 9 | 94 |

Probe tasks (split probe) are in neither pool. They may appear in PREFIX, which only fixes the B prompt.
